title: taskMetrics
responsibility: Aggregates deduplicated module-task events into review, failure, usage and cost totals, grouped by reported or requested model identity.

inputs.name: taskMetrics.events
inputs.description: Recorded analytics events; only task events with moduleTask details contribute, duplicate event IDs collapse to their last value.

outputs.name: taskMetrics
outputs.type: { tasks: number; executions: number; submissions: number; accepted: number; bounces: number; reviewed: number; bounceRate: number | null; executionFailures: number; inputTokens: number | null; outputTokens: number | null; cacheReadTokens: number | null; cacheWriteTokens: number | null; apiCostUsd: number | null; apiCostRangeUsd: { minimum: number | null; maximum: number | null }; unpricedExecutions: number; unreportedUsage: number; byModel: Array<{ provider: string; model: string; intelligence: string; modelSource: string; tasks: number; executions: number; submissions: number; accepted: number; bounces: number; reviewed: number; bounceRate: number | null; executionFailures: number; inputTokens: number | null; outputTokens: number | null; cacheReadTokens: number | null; cacheWriteTokens: number | null; apiCostUsd: number | null; apiCostRangeUsd: { minimum: number | null; maximum: number | null }; unpricedExecutions: number; unreportedUsage: number }> }
outputs.description: Overall and per-model task totals; bounce rate uses accepted plus incomplete reviews, execution failures stay separate, and missing usage or cost inputs produce null totals.
